name: Weighted Stability Ball Back Extension
steps: Rest your hips and lower abdomen on the ball, brace your feet wide against the floor or wall and hug the plate to your chest.
Lower your upper torso smoothly over the curve of the ball with a neutral neck.
Contract your lower back and glutes steadily to lift your chest until your torso forms a straight line with your legs.
Pause briefly at neutral alignment, then lower slowly back over the ball under control.
tips: Stop rising once your body aligns straight rather than overarching sharply into your lower back.
Keep the plate hugged closely to your sternum so the stability ball stays centered beneath you.
